title: HANSARD: A Reference Architecture for Forensic Readiness, Runtime Witnessing, and Graded Attribution in Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.22512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous multi-agent systems nowadays act in finance, software supply chains, and security operations. Already, the first largely AI-orchestrated intrusion campaigns have been reported. Yet, when such a system causes harm, no method can robustly establish what happened, what caused it, or who is accountable. This is because provenance forensics works at the wrong abstraction, formal causality assumes the causal model, and agent auditing trusts self-recording. The target failure mode is, thus, attribution laundering, i.e., spreading an act across redundant agents until none is a but-for cause. Worse, the record is produced by the suspects, which comprises the assumption adopted throughout this work. Agents may therefore anticipate the investigation and the part of logging infrastructure may itself collude. translated_title: HANSARD：自主多智能体AI系统中取证就绪、运行时见证和分级归责的参考架构
translated_abstract: 自主多智能体系统如今活跃于金融、软件供应链和安全运营领域。已有报道称，首批主要由AI编排的入侵活动已经出现。然而，当此类系统造成损害时，没有任何方法能够可靠地确定发生了什么、原因是什么或谁应负责。这是因为溯源取证在错误的抽象层面运作，形式化因果假设了因果模型，而智能体审计则信任自我记录。因此，目标故障模式是归责洗白，即通过在冗余智能体间分散行为，直到没有一个智能体成为“若非”原因。更糟糕的是，记录由嫌疑对象产生，这构成了本工作全程采用的假设。智能体可能预判调查，部分日志基础设施本身也可能共谋。本文提出了HANSARD，一种将问责视为生命周期属性的参考架构。首先，就绪阶段...
tldr: HANSARD提出了一种参考架构，通过将问责制视为生命周期属性，并在就绪、运行时见证和分级归责方面创新设计，来解决自主多智能体系统中的归责洗白和取证不可靠问题。
en_tdlr: HANSARD proposes a reference architecture that treats accountability as a life-cycle property, innovating in readiness, runtime witnessing, and graded attribution to address attribution laundering and unreliable forensics in autonomous multi-agent systems.
